observations: Two Vaporella Steam Irons in a dual-unit carrying case.
Brand 'Vaporella' and model 'Super Rite' are printed on the control panel in photo 1.
Control panel features two orange indicator lights, a power switch, a red indicator light, and a temperature dial.
The iron heads have cork handles and are wrapped in protective mesh.
The power cords are visible and appear to be in good condition.
The case shows some minor surface wear.
